query:
SELECT 
  estadoConfiguravel, 
  COUNT(*) as qtd, 
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(valorTotal AS DECIMAL(15,2))), 2) as total
FROM sales_orders 
WHERE SUBSTRING(dataEmissao, 1, 10) >= '2026-03-01' 
  AND SUBSTRING(dataEmissao, 1, 10) <= '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY estadoConfiguravel
ORDER BY total DESC;
